Hunt - Beaconing via Fixed Interval Conn.description: Proactively hunt for C2 beaconing by detecting outbound connections with suspiciously consistent timing intervals.

commands.description: Calculate standard deviation of connection timing per dest IP — low jitter = beaconing.
commands.command:
index=network sourcetype=firewall action=allowed
| where NOT match(dest_ip,"^(10\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.|192\\.168\\.)")
| bin _time span=1m
| stats count, range(_time) as time_range, stdev(_time) as jitter by src_ip, dest_ip
| where count > 15 AND jitter < 60
| sort jitter

commands.description: Hunt for processes with repetitive outbound connection bursts at fixed intervals.
commands.command:
index=endpoint sourcetype=sysmon EventCode=3
| where NOT match(DestinationIp,"^(10\\.|172\\.|192\\.168\\.)")
| stats count, dc(DestinationPort) as ports, stdev(_time) as jitter by Image, DestinationIp
| where count > 20 AND jitter < 120 AND ports < 3
| sort jitter

Hunt - Beaconing via Fixed Interval Conn.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Splunk data sources for context.

Hunt - DNS Tunneling.description: Proactively hunt for DNS-based C2 and exfiltration using query volume, entropy, and type analysis.

commands.description: High number of unique subdomains per registered domain — tunneling indicator.
commands.command:
index=dns sourcetype=stream:dns
| rex field=query "(?P<subdomain>.+)\.(?P<domain>[^\.]+\.[^\.]+)$"
| stats dc(subdomain) as unique_subs, count by src_ip, domain
| where unique_subs > 100
| sort -unique_subs

commands.description: Abnormally long DNS query names (base64 encoded payload in label).
commands.command:
index=dns sourcetype=stream:dns
| eval query_len=len(query)
| where query_len > 50
| stats count by src_ip, query
| sort -count

commands.description: High volume of TXT record queries per source IP — iodine, dnscat2.
commands.command:
index=dns sourcetype=stream:dns record_type=TXT
| stats count by src_ip, query
| where count > 20
| sort -count

commands.description: DNS NXDOMAIN flood — DGA domain generation activity.
commands.command:
index=dns sourcetype=stream:dns reply_code=NXDOMAIN
| stats count, dc(query) as unique_domains by src_ip, span(_time,5m)
| where count > 50
| sort -count

Hunt - DNS Tunneling.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Splunk data sources for context.

commands.description: LSASS handle open by unexpected process (Sysmon 10 — ProcessAccess).

commands.description: comsvcs.dll MiniDump via rundll32 — fileless LSASS dump.

commands.description: procdump or tasklist targeting lsass process.

commands.description: LSASS dump file written to disk — large .dmp file creation.

index=wineventlog EventCode=4104

commands.description: WmiPrvSE spawning shell or script interpreter.

Hunt - Pass-the-Hash & Lateral Movement.description: Proactively hunt for NTLM-based lateral movement and credential reuse attacks.

commands.description: NTLM network logon from host that normally uses Kerberos (Event 4624 Type 3).
commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4624 LogonType=3 AuthenticationPackageName=NTLM
| where NOT match(TargetUserName,"(?i)(\\$$|ANONYMOUS LOGON|-$)")
| stats count by src_ip, TargetUserName, host
| where count < 3
| sort count

commands.description: PtH tool artifacts — impacket, wmiexec, smbexec process execution.
commands.command:
index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog EventCode=1
| where match(CommandLine,"(?i)(-hashes|-H [a-f0-9]{32}|wmiexec|smbexec|atexec)")

commands.description: Overpass-the-Hash — NTLM authentication followed by Kerberos TGT request from same host.
commands.command:
index=wineventlog (EventCode=4624 LogonType=9) OR (EventCode=4768)
| transaction host maxspan=30s startswith=(EventCode=4624) endswith=(EventCode=4768)
| where eventcount >= 2
| table _time, host, TargetUserName, src_ip

commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17
| where NOT match(ServiceName,"\\$$")
| stats count by src_ip, TargetUserName, ServiceName
| sort -count

index=wineventlog EventCode=4768 PreAuthType=0 Status=0x0
| table _time, host, TargetUserName, src_ip

index=wineventlog EventCode=4662
| where match(Properties,"(1131f6aa|1131f6ad|89e95b76)")

commands.description: Golden Ticket — TGS without preceding TGT in session.
commands.command:
index=wineventlog EventCode=4769
| transaction TargetUserName maxspan=1h startswith=(EventCode=4768) endswith=(EventCode=4769)
| where eventcount == 1 AND match(EventCode,"4769")
| table _time, host, TargetUserName, ServiceName, src_ip

commands.description: Single host connecting to >20 unique internal hosts on port 445 (SMB scan).
commands.command:
index=network sourcetype=firewall dest_port=445
| where match(dest_ip,"^(10\\.|172\\.|192\\.168\\.)")
| stats dc(dest_ip) as targets by src_ip, span(_time,10m)

commands.description: ICMP sweep — one IP pinging >50 unique hosts per minute.

commands.description: Port sweep — single source connecting to >10 unique ports on same host.

commands.description: nmap, masscan, or rustscan process execution detected.

index=linux sourcetype=auditd

commands.description: LD_PRELOAD environment variable set — rootkit loader.

commands.description: Setuid binary created outside standard system directories.

| where match(mode,"4[0-9]{3}")
  AND NOT match(name,"(?i)(/bin/|/sbin/|/usr/|/lib/)")
| table _time, host, uid, name, mode
